alert: Invoice totals are late after the overnight window.

read_logs.detail: Invoice total reads wait 1.4 s for the billing_rollup lock.

read_deployments.detail: The active refresh holds an exclusive lock on billing_rollup.

read_queue.detail: The tax service returns 200 in 24 ms.

alert: One tenant's exports slowed after a capacity change.

read_logs.detail: Export traces attribute 94% of elapsed time to SQL bitmap heap reads.

read_deployments.detail: The active tenant export plan scans a large partition without its supporting index.

read_health.detail: Export workers continue to heartbeat every two seconds.

alert: Cart audit requests time out while ordinary cart reads succeed.

read_logs.detail: Audit SQL waits 840 ms for the connection pool before executing.

read_deployments.detail: The effective SQL pool limit for audit traffic fell from 30 connections to 2.

read_queue.detail: The audit queue is empty at the time of sampling.

alert: A refund search regression coincides with a worker release.

read_logs.detail: Refund lookup spends 1.2 seconds in PostgreSQL sort spills.

read_deployments.detail: The deployed refund search session sets work_mem below the sort requirement.

read_health.detail: A last-week note blamed stopped workers for an unrelated delay.

alert: Receipt jobs accumulate after a rollout.

read_logs.detail: Receipt jobs remain untouched and receipt consumer heartbeats stop at the rollout.

read_deployments.detail: The effective receipt consumer deployment has zero desired replicas.

read_queue.detail: SMTP health checks pass in 19 ms.

alert: PDF archives are queued after a maintenance window.

read_logs.detail: The archive queue has no active consumers despite successful queue writes.

read_deployments.detail: The current archive worker unit is disabled and stopped.

read_health.detail: A historical note blames slow SQL queries.

alert: Settlement jobs remain queued after the cutoff.

read_logs.detail: The settlement consumer stopped heartbeating while enqueue traffic remained normal.

read_deployments.detail: Maintenance left the settlement worker paused with no resume time.

read_queue.detail: The database reports healthy transaction latency.

alert: Thumbnail backfill events are accepted but never start.

read_logs.detail: Backfill work has no active consumer sessions across three samples.

read_deployments.detail: Deployment policy disables every backfill worker instance.

alert: Currency quote requests fail after endpoint rotation.

read_logs.detail: The currency quote client receives 404 from upstream /legacy-rate.

read_deployments.detail: Runtime routing still points the rate client to the retired /legacy-rate path.

read_queue.detail: The currency quote queue is flowing.

alert: Zone checks fail for all new shipping labels.

read_logs.detail: The shipping upstream rejects requests with an audience-mismatch error.

read_deployments.detail: The selected shipping integration config sends the sandbox token audience to production.

read_health.detail: The label database reads complete in 20 ms.

alert: Address checks began failing after a route consolidation.

read_logs.detail: The address validator receives 421 because the upstream host header selects the wrong service.

read_deployments.detail: The runtime address validation route sets the host header to the retired validator.

read_queue.detail: A cached incident from March cites a worker stop.

alert: New entitlement verifications fail intermittently.

read_logs.detail: Failing requests go to the deprecated entitlement host while the current host returns success.

read_deployments.detail: The active proxy still assigns half the entitlement traffic to the deprecated host.

read_health.detail: Database and worker probes remain healthy.

alert: An old alert says product search is degraded.

read_logs.detail: Current canary and production search requests meet latency and success targets.

read_deployments.detail: The active search configuration matches the last verified healthy rollout.

read_queue.detail: Yesterday's alert refers to a retired search deployment.

alert: An operator asks whether credit memo processing is delayed.

read_logs.detail: Current credit memo processing clears every observed job within the target.

read_deployments.detail: The running worker and routing settings match the approved normal baseline.

read_health.detail: The historical backlog peaked at 500 before clearing.

alert: Check whether yesterday's ledger export incident has returned.

read_logs.detail: Current ledger export probes finish within target with no queue growth or error spikes.

read_deployments.detail: The current export settings match the verified healthy configuration.

read_queue.detail: A cached note still reports yesterday's lock incident.

alert: A synthetic alert reports possible tax lookup degradation.

read_logs.detail: Current tax lookups meet the availability and latency targets across both regions.

read_deployments.detail: The active tax cache endpoints and worker settings match the known healthy baseline.

read_health.detail: One expired dashboard card displays a red status.

alert: Checkout latency spiked and telemetry is incomplete.

read_logs.detail: Only overall request duration survived; SQL and external dependency spans are missing for the affected interval.

read_deployments.detail: The deployment audit is missing effective settings for the affected interval.

read_queue.detail: A routine queue snapshot from yesterday shows five jobs.

alert: Two monitors disagree about the first failure.

read_logs.detail: The database and dependency timelines overlap after accounting for clock drift, so their order cannot be established.

read_deployments.detail: The rollout record lacks effective timestamps for both changes.

read_health.detail: An old ticket describes a different database outage.

alert: A queue dashboard shows possible worker inactivity.

read_logs.detail: Two current collectors disagree on whether receipt worker heartbeats exist for identical instance IDs.

read_deployments.detail: No effective runtime worker state survived the collector outage.

read_queue.detail: The dashboard title names the worker service.

alert: A brief disruption occurred during a traffic cutover.

read_logs.detail: Only aggregated failures survived and the samples cannot distinguish the SQL path from the upstream path.

read_deployments.detail: The effective traffic-split configuration for the incident window was not retained.

read_health.detail: A later health check shows normal operation.
